title: Water level breach at Tawa embankment
description: Embankment monitoring sensors report a 40cm overflow near Tawa dam, section 3.

title: Fire line jumped containment ridge
description: Wind shift pushed the fire line past the eastern containment trench near Pachmarhi.

title: Oxygen cylinder stock depleted
description: Govindpura Health Unit reports zero oxygen cylinders in reserve.

title: Shelter overcapacity: Sohagpur School
description: Occupancy at 99.6% of rated capacity; additional shelter site requested.

title: Access road cleared near Sheopur
description: Highway NH-552 reopened to relief convoys after debris clearance.

title: Heatwave advisory lifted
description: Cooling monsoon front has brought temperatures below advisory threshold.
